qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Local laundry route density provides operational scale, but heavy capital intensity, competitive B2B rental tenders, and high acquisition goodwill keep 5-year median GAAP ROIC at 7.2%, well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power). Route-dense commercial laundry and textile rental model generates stable cash flow, but heavy capital expenditure (industrial laundries and vehicle fleets) combined with €4.6B of acquisition goodwill keeps 5-year median GAAP ROIC at 7.2% (FY22: 4.6%, FY23: 6.3%, FY24: 8.1%, FY25: 8.3%), failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Elis provides flat linen, workwear, and hygiene services across Europe and Latin America. While route density provides local scale, commercial tenders are price-sensitive. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 7.21% (peaking at 8.27% in FY25), falling far short of the 12.0% hurdle. Capex absorbs €890M annually against €648M EBIT.
